entries.speaker: Girl Wearing Shujin Uniform
entries.en: Ah, so you're a transfer student.

entries.speaker: Girl Wearing Shujin Uniform
entries.en: We're practically in the same boat, then—[n]I started at Shujin just this month.

entries.speaker: Girl Wearing Shujin Uniform
entries.en: Although, I am one year below you.
I'll keep my name to myself.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Being standoffish doesn't suit you well...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Won't you tell me your name, Senpai?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Still... I'm not a fan of what happened[n]earlier.
What a way to start the day.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Oh, you mean the man who[n]accosted me?

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: Yeah, he wasn't exactly being polite,[n]but...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: What bothered me even more was[n]how the people around us reacted.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: It's not like I wanted them all to intervene[n]or something...

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: But they all mouthed off without actually[n]doing anything... They may as well have[n]just ignored me entirely.

entries.speaker: Kasumi
entries.en: I forgot I have class duties today![n]I've got to rush—please excuse me!
